title: Woman Posing Outdoors, 1962 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot from April 1962 capturing a smiling woman posing outdoors with her hands on her hips. She is dressed in a dark button-front coat and dark skirt. Behind her is a dense evergreen hedge and the structural line of a house roof overhead. A processing timestamp reading 'APR 62' is printed vertically along the right border.
